description: Agent Aviation Records: submit aircraft inspection records with the schedule, corrective entries and flight log they answer to: the moment the records are read at; each scheduled inspection with its id, reference, tail number, the inspection, the moment due and the days the program states between these inspections; each inspection record with its id, reference, the scheduled inspection it completes, tail number, the inspection and the moments it opens and closes; each inspection finding with its id, reference, the inspection record, tail number and the finding recorded; each corrective entry with its id, reference, the finding it corrects, tail number and the moment corrected; each flight log entry with its id, reference, tail number and the moment flown. The signed report gives the schedule and the inspection records, each scheduled inspection due by the reading moment against a closed inspection record behind it, each inspection finding against a corrective entry, each flight against the inspections open on its aircraft, and each pair of completed inspections against the interval the program states, and counts them, and names divergent inspection records: a scheduled inspection with no completed record behind it, an inspection finding recorded with no corrective entry, an aircraft back in the flight log before the inspection record closes, and an inspection interval in the record that the completed inspections do not match; then an inspection record naming a scheduled inspection the schedule does not hold and a corrective entry naming a finding the records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No schedule, or a schedule with due dates and no reading moment, leaves those points unverified. Tail numbers, inspections, findings and entries match by letters and digits, inspection kinds by their words, a scheduled inspection due on or before the reading moment needs an inspection record naming it closed by then, a flight dated after an inspection opens and before it closes puts the aircraft back early, and completed inspections of one kind on one aircraft read by the day against the interval. This reads the aircraft inspection records in the operator’s own file: wever_auto-inspection-check reads a vehicle inspection report against its checklist, while the inspection check reads whether every scheduled aircraft inspection closed, every finding was corrected and no aircraft flew before its inspection closed. Verdict aviation_inspection_divergent, aviation_inspection_partial, aviation_inspection_unverified or aviation_inspection_consistent. POST /api/aviation-inspection-check. Reads the aviation records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it flies no aircraft, inspects no aircraft in person, contacts no regulator, examiner or maintenance provider and issues no certification, which stay with the operator, its pilots, its mechanics and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Aviation Records reads an air operator’s own records: flight log records, aircraft maintenance records, airworthiness and directive records, inspection records, pilot certificate records, training and currency records, flight duty and rest records and incident report records, each against the fleet, maintenance, pilot and duty records, the mechanic, certificate and part records, the flight log and the maintenance record, the aircraft, operations and dates flown, the schedule and the corrective entries, the required events and the currency records, the operator’s own limits, or the follow-up entries on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the aircraft and the crew: what the flight log shows, what the maintenance record supports, what the certificates cover, and whether the duty and incident records hold up; it reads records about aircraft and crews, not live flight tracking and not travel booking: the Agent Travel family reads the bookings behind a trip, the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records and the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety file, while this family reads an air operator’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-aviation-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-aviation-records/.

as_of.description: The reading moment, such as 2026-03-02 or 2026-03-02T14:30Z.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

every_days.description: Days the program states between these inspections.
